title: Construction of smart switchable nanoplatforms for adaptive phototheranostics
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, 55,2325-2354
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00736D, Review Article
Yuewen Yu, Yubo Liu, Le Zhang, Congbin Fan, Ben Zhong Tang, Guangxue Feng
This review highlights the recent advances in smart switchable nanoplatforms that could change their phototheranostic modalities to best fit the heterogenous and dynamically changed tumor microenvironments for adaptive phototheranostics.
